title: Exactly: and that is the ineluctable modality of the
html_source:
Stephen was aware of thoughts being filtered from the world into his mind via the senses at the start of the chapter- ‘thought through my eyes’. Here Joyce settles his own silt on us with the nacheinder/nebeneinder duality applying to the reader too. We access the book via a nacheinander sequence of words from which we construct, via whatever sense Joyce gives us, the strandscape which constitutes a nebeneinander.

ACCEPTED SUGGESTION: Come back to us…
